name: slicing_study_vint_parallel
_comment: Board verification for qnn_models/slicing_study: ViNT sliced in branch mode so its two EfficientNet-b0 encoders are independent tiles. The point of the run is the trace -- do vint_goal_enc and vint_obs_enc actually overlap in wall-clock time on two lanes, as the makespan model predicts (goal on CPU int8 6.6 ms alongside obs on DSP 9.5 ms), or does the runtime serialise them?
